description:
## [1.5.6](https://github.com/YYDarlinker/morphe-ai-caption-translator/compare/v1.5.5...v1.5.6) (2026-10-22)

### Compatibility

- Rebuilt for **Morphe Patcher 2.0.0** and official **Morphe Patches 1.48.0**. The bundle now declares `Patcher-Version: 2.0.0` and requires the 2.x patcher.
- YouTube targets now follow the 21.x list of official 1.48.0: **21.42.241, 21.41.525, 21.28.208, 21.23.492** (experimental), plus stable **21.20.405** and **21.16.256**. All 20.x targets are removed, and 1.47.0-era targets such as 21.40.161, 21.39.522 and 21.38.130 are no longer declared.
- Removed the add-on's own **Auto-translate language list** and its menu/metadata hooks. YouTube's native list and the official Captions patch now own the available languages and their order.
- Fixed a `VerifyError` in the player flyout menu with Morphe Patches 1.48.0 / YouTube 21.20.405 that could crash when opening the quick menu.

### Caption experience

- Captions now sit **above the player controls**, so the progress bar and time labels cannot cover them. The topmost player-overlay container also receives the drag directly, removing the extra full-screen touch proxy.
- One stable caption layer is used across the detail page, fullscreen, Shorts and the comments sheet. Caption size and pagination follow the real video viewport instead of a transient container rectangle.
- The comments sheet now changes the caption reading size **continuously with its animation** (55.5↔44.5): it starts and finishes with the panel instead of changing after the animation ends. Pagination still commits only at the endpoint, so the animation does not repaginate on every frame.
- Fixed caption boxes running past the screen edge on the detail page after returning from fullscreen. A frame captured during rotation no longer becomes a permanent over-wide box.
- Shorts captions use the detail reading size and opening Shorts comments no longer changes the size or rebuilds the page. A one-line Shorts page no longer inherits a two-line box height.
- The caption background now follows the current page's actual text width, so a short page no longer shows the widest page's empty box.

### AI captions

- The add-on now fully follows the official CC authority. Captions appear only while YouTube's CC control is on and a native track is selected; if a video starts with CC off or without a default translated track, no AI target captions are shown, even if the previous video used Auto-translate.
- The AI switch only chooses the drawing style: on means the AI overlay, off means the native subtitle view. It does not create captions when the official CC control is off.
- The engine starts from the new video's already-captured native selection at video switch, with a short retry if the track list is still arriving. Turning AI on no longer waits for a later video or another manual toggle.
- The add-on follows YouTube's native language authority and does not keep a target across videos. If the native selection is a source track, the AI overlay displays that source text rather than inventing a translation.

**Upgrade note:** 1.5.6 requires official Morphe Patches **1.48.0** and Patcher **2.0.0**, and is limited to the YouTube 21.x targets listed above. Users who must stay on official 1.47.0 should keep 1.5.5.
